name: financial-report-layout
display_name: Financial Report Layout — Proforma / Projection Dashboard
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint), letter-landscape proforma/projection dashboard document register, extracted verbatim from a delivered financial-report deliverable. A sibling of financial-statement-yearend, not the same register — different page geometry (landscape vs. portrait), density (up to 11 period columns vs. 3), and tone (tinted semantic-row fills + navy banner vs. pure black-on-white). Two internal themes: dashboard (delivered, real) and statement (classic compliance look) — the statement theme's own token values are PROVISIONAL, gated on not-yet-implemented proforma-engine work.

variants.name: masthead
variants.description: H1 + draft-status line + BCSC-compliance footer scaffold.

variants.name: wide-table
variants.description: Multi-period fixed-layout table — up to 11 data columns, label column 25% (dashboard) / 22% (statement-theme bundle, provisional).

variants.name: section-banner
variants.description: Full-width navy-ink section header row (banner-bg fill, banner-ink text — the only colored text in the family).

variants.name: subtotal-row
variants.description: Subtotal row — tinted fill + top hairline rule.

variants.name: total-row
variants.description: Total row — stronger tint + top standard rule.

variants.name: line-gutter
variants.description: JS-injected line-number gutter, Courier New, 32px — dashboard/screen only; absent from the print/WeasyPrint output and from the statement theme entirely.

variants.name: theme-statement
variants.description: PROVISIONAL classic-compliance theme — serif stack, no fills, single-then-double rule convention. Gated on BRIEF-bencal-proforma-engine-recapitalization.md's not-yet-implemented engine work; do not treat as equally final to the dashboard theme.

aria: Wide tables use <table><caption> naming the reporting period range; section-banner rows use <th scope="colgroup"> where they span the full table width. The line-number gutter is presentational only (aria-hidden) — it is not part of any data relationship.

wcag.note: Dashboard theme's tinted semantic rows (total/subtotal/banner) are never color-only differentiators — each also carries a distinct font-weight and rule treatment.

motion: Print-first static document (dashboard theme also renders on-screen with the line-gutter feature) — no interactive states beyond that.
open_questions: oq-1: the statement-theme's serif font stack and exact column split (22% + 10x7.8%) are PROVISIONAL — wcp.finance.* bundle values, gated on unfinished proforma-engine Rust work. Do not commit these as final without re-verifying against the engine once it lands.

oq-2: page-number placement (@bottom-right, standard running counter) is a deliberate divergence from financial-statement-yearend's @bottom-center Notes-only convention — both are correct for their own family, not drift to reconcile.
